'''Gerata''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he resided on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Gerata was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as Republic-side vendor for Galactic Command system.
